rca of the issue: Previous iteration_14 defect was caused by SECTIONS array listing bd-news BEFORE cta, while the DOM rendered cta BEFORE bd-news. The candidate loop iterated SECTIONS in array order and ended on the last id whose top<=headerOffset, which was cta. Fix applied by main agent in this iteration does two things: (1) SECTIONS reordered to [hero, joy-beast, experience-centre, tech-stack, value-prop, cta, bd-news] to match DOM, and (2) rects.sort((a,b)=>a.top-b.top) added before the candidate loop so future DOM re-ordering cannot reintroduce the same bug. Both are correct and independently sufficient.
